name: Explainable AI -- A Comprehensive Seminar on Transparent and Ethical AI
description:
The rapid advancement and adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) across various domains have sparked concerns about the interpretability and transparency of AI systems. This MSc seminar aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of Explainable AI, focusing on techniques and best practices to make AI systems more interpretable, transparent, and accountable.

Participants will delve into a range of topics, including the importance of explainable AI, explanation techniques, interpretability in machine learning and deep learning models, post-hoc explanation methods, and their usefulness for human-AI interaction. The seminar will also address the ethical, social, and regulatory aspects of AI, exploring the role of transparency in fairness, bias mitigation, and compliance with data protection regulations.
prerequisites: Interest in mathematical, statistical methods, and AI in general.
